messages.content: Yall said someone would call. Its been like 30 hours now. Whats the holdup?
Hi - I'm sorry for the delay. Let me check on that for you right now.
Need to talk to a nurse about my readings. My blood sugar has been weird all week
I can log those readings to get them on file. But for guidance on what they mean, a nurse needs to call you. Median wait time right now is about 31 hours.
31 hours?! That's not what I signed up for. This is supposed to be better than going to the clinic
I understand the frustration - that's longer than we want either. I'm marking you high priority for nurse escalation right now. Someone will call you about those readings as soon as they can.
Alright. Can you just tell me if theyre bad or what I should do?
I can't give clinical advice - that's something only a nurse can do. But tell me your readings and I'll log them so the nurse has everything when they call.

theme: asks how long a nurse will take to call back, frustrated after 30 hours
